title: Questions for a Tomball Roofing Contractor
description: A roofing contractor in Tomball, or a roofing company serving Houston, should say who is on the roof, what the deck looks like, and where the shop is.
html:
Searching "roofing contractor Tomball TX" or "roofing companies in Houston" turns up a long list. The useful questions are the same either way. You want a crew you can find next year, not a lead that got sold this afternoon.

Ask these before anyone gets on the roof

  • Where is the shop, and who shows up on the day? Ours is 22955 State Highway 249, Suite 26, Tomball.
  • Is this a repair or a tear-off, and what would change that answer once the deck is open?
  • Who pulls the permit, and which city is it filed in?
  • What does the contract say about dry-in if the weather turns, and about matching shingles if it is only a repair?
  • Who do you call when something leaks six months later?

The longer version of the paperwork is before you sign a roofing contract. Matching a repair is its own problem, covered in matching shingles after a repair.

Local does not mean one city

Tomball is the shop. The work runs through Tomball, Cypress, Spring, The Woodlands, and the rest of greater Houston. The map of that is service areas, and the Tomball page is residential roofing in Tomball. If the house needs a new roof rather than a longer interview, start at roof replacement.

Request a free inspection, or call (281) 541-0027.
